verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הוֹדַ֥ע אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֶת־ תּוֹעֲבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hō·w·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim ’eṯ- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Son of man confront Jerusalem with her abominations
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, faze conhecer a Jerusalém todas as suas abominações,

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־ אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ לִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מְכֹרֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וּמֹ֣לְדֹתַ֔יִךְ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י אָבִ֥יךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְאִמֵּ֥ךְ חִתִּֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh lî·rū·šā·lim mə·ḵō·rō·ṯa·yiḵ ū·mō·lə·ḏō·ṯa·yiḵ mê·’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ’ā·ḇîḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’im·mêḵ ḥit·tîṯ
verses.literal: and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem Your origin and your birth were in the land of the Canaanites Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite
verses.literalPt: e dize: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová a Jerusalém: A tua origem e a tua natividade, vem da terra dos cananeus; o amorreu era teu pai, e tua mãe era heteia.

verses.original: וּמוֹלְדוֹתַ֗יִךְ בְּי֨וֹם הוּלֶּ֤דֶת אֹתָךְ֙ לֹֽא־ כָרַּ֣ת שָׁרֵּ֔ךְ וּבְמַ֥יִם לֹֽא־ רֻחַ֖צְתְּ לְמִשְׁעִ֑י וְהָמְלֵ֙חַ֙ לֹ֣א הֻמְלַ֔חַתְּ וְהָחְתֵּ֖ל לֹ֥א חֻתָּֽלְתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·wl·ḏō·w·ṯa·yiḵ bə·yō·wm hūl·le·ḏeṯ ’ō·ṯāḵ lō- ḵār·raṯ šār·rêḵ ū·ḇə·ma·yim lō- ru·ḥaṣt lə·miš·‘î wə·hā·mə·lê·aḥ lō hum·la·ḥat wə·hā·ḥə·têl lō ḥut·tā·lət
verses.literal: On the day of your birth your cord was not cut nor were you washed with water for cleansing You were not rubbed with salt . . . or wrapped in cloths . . .
verses.literalPt: Quanto à tua natividade, no dia em que nasceste, não te foi cortado o umbigo, nem foste lavada na água para te limpar; não foste esfregada com sal, nem envolta em faixas.

verses.original: לֹא־ חָ֨סָה עָלַ֜יִךְ עַ֗יִן לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֛ךְ אַחַ֥ת מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לְחֻמְלָ֣ה עָלָ֑יִךְ וַֽתֻּשְׁלְכִ֞י אֶל־ פְּנֵ֤י הַשָּׂדֶה֙ בְּגֹ֣עַל נַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ בְּי֖וֹם הֻלֶּ֥דֶת אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ḥā·sāh ‘ā·la·yiḵ ‘a·yin la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lāḵ ’a·ḥaṯ mê·’êl·leh lə·ḥum·lāh ‘ā·lā·yiḵ wat·tuš·lə·ḵî ’el- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh bə·ḡō·‘al nap̄·šêḵ bə·yō·wm hul·le·ḏeṯ ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: No one cared enough . . . for you to do even one of these things out of compassion for you Instead, you were thrown out into the open field because you were despised on the day of your birth
verses.literalPt: Não se apiedou de ti olho algum, para te fazer alguma dessas coisas, compadecendo-se de ti; porém no dia em que nasceste, foste arrojado fora no campo, porque tiveram nojo de ti.

verses.original: וָאֶעֱבֹ֤ר עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ וָֽאֶרְאֵ֔ךְ מִתְבּוֹסֶ֖סֶת בְּדָמָ֑יִךְ וָאֹ֤מַר לָךְ֙ בְּדָמַ֣יִךְ חֲיִ֔י וָאֹ֥מַר לָ֖ךְ בְּדָמַ֥יִךְ חֲיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’er·’êḵ miṯ·bō·w·se·seṯ bə·ḏā·mā·yiḵ wā·’ō·mar lāḵ bə·ḏā·ma·yiḵ ḥă·yî wā·’ō·mar lāḵ bə·ḏā·ma·yiḵ ḥă·yî
verses.literal: Then I passed by and saw you wallowing in your blood and as you lay there in your blood I said to you Live There I said to you Live
verses.literalPt: Então, passei junto de ti e, vendo-te envolta no teu sangue, te disse: Ainda que estás no teu sangue, vive.

verses.original: רְבָבָ֗ה כְּצֶ֤מַח הַשָּׂדֶה֙ נְתַתִּ֔יךְ וַתִּרְבִּי֙ וַֽתִּגְדְּלִ֔י וַתָּבֹ֖אִי בַּעֲדִ֣י עֲדָיִ֑ים שָׁדַ֤יִם נָכֹ֙נוּ֙ וּשְׂעָרֵ֣ךְ צִמֵּ֔חַ וְאַ֖תְּ עֵרֹ֥ם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ḇā·ḇāh kə·ṣe·maḥ haś·śā·ḏeh nə·ṯat·tîḵ wat·tir·bî wat·tiḡ·də·lî wat·tā·ḇō·’î ba·‘ă·ḏî ‘ă·ḏā·yîm šā·ḏa·yim nā·ḵō·nū ū·śə·‘ā·rêḵ ṣim·mê·aḥ wə·’at ‘ê·rōm wə·‘er·yāh
verses.literal: I made you thrive like a plant of the field You grew up and matured and became . . . very beautiful Your breasts were formed and your hair grew but you were naked and bare
verses.literalPt: Eu te fiz multiplicar como o renovo do campo, cresceste, e te engrandeceste, e chegaste à grande formosura. Formaram-se os teus peitos, e cresceram os teus cabelos; contudo, estavas nua e despida.

verses.original: וָאֶעֱבֹ֨ר עָלַ֜יִךְ וָאֶרְאֵ֗ךְ וְהִנֵּ֤ה עִתֵּךְ֙ עֵ֣ת דֹּדִ֔ים וָאֶפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וָאֲכַסֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתֵ֑ךְ וָאֶשָּׁ֣בַֽע לָ֠ךְ וָאָב֨וֹא בִבְרִ֜ית אֹתָ֗ךְ נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה וַתִּ֥הְיִי לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’er·’êḵ wə·hin·nêh ‘it·têḵ ‘êṯ dō·ḏîm wā·’ep̄·rōś kə·nā·p̄î ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’ă·ḵas·seh ‘er·wā·ṯêḵ wā·’eš·šā·ḇa‘ lāḵ wā·’ā·ḇō·w ḇiḇ·rîṯ ’ō·ṯāḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wat·tih·yî lî
verses.literal: Then I passed by and saw you and you were indeed old enough . . . for love So I spread My cloak over you and covered your nakedness I pledged Myself to you entered into a covenant with you and you became Mine declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Então, passei junto de ti, olhei para ti, e eis que o teu tempo era tempo de amores. Estendi sobre ti a minha capa e cobri a tua nudez; sim, dei-te juramento e entrei em aliança contigo, diz o Senhor Jeová, e tu ficaste sendo minha.

verses.original: וָאֶרְחָצֵ֣ךְ בַּמַּ֔יִם וָאֶשְׁטֹ֥ף דָּמַ֖יִךְ מֵֽעָלָ֑יִךְ וָאֲסֻכֵ֖ךְ בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’er·ḥā·ṣêḵ bam·ma·yim wā·’eš·ṭōp̄ dā·ma·yiḵ mê·‘ā·lā·yiḵ wā·’ă·su·ḵêḵ baš·šā·men
verses.literal: Then I bathed you with water rinsed off your blood . . . and anointed you with oil
verses.literalPt: Então, te lavei na água, e te limpei do teu sangue, e te ungi com óleo.

verses.original: וָאַלְבִּישֵׁ֣ךְ רִקְמָ֔ה וָאֶנְעֲלֵ֖ךְ תָּ֑חַשׁ וָאֶחְבְּשֵׁ֣ךְ בַּשֵּׁ֔שׁ וַאֲכַסֵּ֖ךְ מֶֽשִׁי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’al·bî·šêḵ riq·māh wā·’en·‘ă·lêḵ tā·ḥaš wā·’eḥ·bə·šêḵ baš·šêš wa·’ă·ḵas·sêḵ me·šî
verses.literal: I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of fine leather I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk
verses.literalPt: Também te vesti de roupas bordadas, e te calcei de pele de focas, e te cingi de linho fino, e te cobri de seda.

verses.original: וָאֶעְדֵּ֖ךְ עֶ֑דִי וָאֶתְּנָ֤ה צְמִידִים֙ עַל־ יָדַ֔יִךְ וְרָבִ֖יד עַל־ גְּרוֹנֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’e‘·dêḵ ‘e·ḏî wā·’et·tə·nāh ṣə·mî·ḏîm ‘al- yā·ḏa·yiḵ wə·rā·ḇîḏ ‘al- gə·rō·w·nêḵ
verses.literal: I adorned you with jewelry and I put bracelets on your wrists and a chain around your neck
verses.literalPt: Também te enfeitei com adornos e te pus braceletes nas mãos e um colar ao redor do teu pescoço.

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֥ן נֶ֙זֶם֙ עַל־ אַפֵּ֔ךְ וַעֲגִילִ֖ים עַל־ אָזְנָ֑יִךְ וַעֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת בְּרֹאשֵֽׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tên ne·zem ‘al- ’ap·pêḵ wa·‘ă·ḡî·lîm ‘al- ’ā·zə·nā·yiḵ wa·‘ă·ṭe·reṯ tip̄·’e·reṯ bə·rō·šêḵ
verses.literal: I put a ring in your nose earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown upon your head
verses.literalPt: Eu te pus um pendente no nariz, e arrecadas nas orelhas, e uma bela coroa na cabeça.

verses.original: וַתַּעְדִּ֞י זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֗סֶף וּמַלְבּוּשֵׁךְ֙ שֵׁשִׁי וָמֶ֙שִׁי֙ וְרִקְמָ֔ה סֹ֧לֶת וּדְבַ֛שׁ וָשֶׁ֖מֶן אָכָלְתִּי וַתִּ֙יפִי֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַֽתִּצְלְחִ֖י לִמְלוּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta‘·dî zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ ū·mal·bū·šêḵ šē·šī wā·me·šî wə·riq·māh sō·leṯ ū·ḏə·ḇaš wā·še·men ʾå̄·ḵå̄·lə·tī wat·tî·p̄î bim·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ wat·tiṣ·lə·ḥî lim·lū·ḵāh
verses.literal: So you were adorned with gold and silver and your clothing was made of fine linen silk and embroidered cloth You ate fine flour honey and oil You became very . . . beautiful and rose to be queen
verses.literalPt: Assim, foste enfeitada de ouro e prata; o teu vestido era de linho fino, de seda e de bordados; nutriste-te da flor de farinha, e de mel, e de azeite; eras em extremo formosa e chegaste a ter estado real.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨צֵא לָ֥ךְ שֵׁ֛ם בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם בְּיָפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּ֣י׀ כָּלִ֣יל ה֗וּא בַּֽהֲדָרִי֙ אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֣מְתִּי עָלַ֔יִךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê lāḵ šêm bag·gō·w·yim bə·yā·p̄ə·yêḵ kî kā·lîl hū ba·hă·ḏā·rî ’ă·šer- śam·tî ‘ā·la·yiḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty for it was perfect in the splendor I bestowed on you declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Espalhou-se o teu renome entre as nações, por causa da tua formosura; porque era perfeita devido à minha majestade que eu tinha posto em ti, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וַתִּבְטְחִ֣י בְיָפְיֵ֔ךְ וַתִּזְנִ֖י עַל־ שְׁמֵ֑ךְ וַתִּשְׁפְּכִ֧י אֶת־ תַּזְנוּתַ֛יִךְ עַל־ כָּל־ עוֹבֵ֖ר לוֹ־ יֶֽהִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḇ·ṭə·ḥî ḇə·yā·p̄ə·yêḵ wat·tiz·nî ‘al- šə·mêḵ wat·tiš·pə·ḵî ’eṯ- taz·nū·ṯa·yiḵ ‘al- kāl- ‘ō·w·ḇêr lōw- ye·hî
verses.literal: But because of your fame you trusted in your beauty and played the harlot You lavished your favors on everyone who passed by and your beauty was theirs for the asking
verses.literalPt: Porém confiaste na tua formosura, e fornicaste por causa do teu renome, e derramaste as tuas fornicações sobre todo o que passava; estavas ao seu dispor.

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֣י מִבְּגָדַ֗יִךְ וַתַּֽעֲשִׂי־ לָךְ֙ בָּמ֣וֹת טְלֻא֔וֹת וַתִּזְנִ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א בָא֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ḥî mib·bə·ḡā·ḏa·yiḵ wat·ta·‘ă·śî- lāḵ bā·mō·wṯ ṭə·lu·’ō·wṯ wat·tiz·nî ‘ă·lê·hem lō ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·lō yih·yeh
verses.literal: You took some of your garments and made colorful high places for yourself and on them you prostituted yourself Such things should not have happened never should they have occurred
verses.literalPt: Tomaste dos teus vestidos, e te fizeste altos, enfeitados de diversas cores, e fornicaste sobre eles. Coisas semelhantes não virão, nem assim sucederão.

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֞י כְּלֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗ךְ מִזְּהָבִ֤י וּמִכַּסְפִּי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ וַתַּעֲשִׂי־ לָ֖ךְ צַלְמֵ֣י זָכָ֑ר וַתִּזְנִי־ בָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ḥî kə·lê ṯip̄·’ar·têḵ miz·zə·hā·ḇî ū·mik·kas·pî ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lāḵ wat·ta·‘ă·śî- lāḵ ṣal·mê zā·ḵār wat·tiz·nî- ḇām
verses.literal: You also took the fine jewelry of gold and silver I had given you and you made male idols with which to prostitute yourself
verses.literalPt: Também tomaste as tuas belas joias, feitas do meu ouro e da minha prata que eu te havia dado, e te fizeste imagens de homens, e fornicaste com elas;

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֛י אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתֵ֖ךְ וַתְּכַסִּ֑ים וְשַׁמְנִי֙ וּקְטָרְתִּ֔י נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ḥî ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê riq·mā·ṯêḵ wat·tə·ḵas·sîm wə·šam·nî ū·qə·ṭā·rə·tî nå̄·ṯat·tī lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: You took your embroidered garments to cover them and you set My oil and incense before them
verses.literalPt: tomaste os teus vestidos bordados, e as cobriste, e puseste diante delas o meu azeite e o meu incenso.

verses.original: וְלַחְמִי֩ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֨תִּי לָ֜ךְ סֹ֣לֶת וָשֶׁ֤מֶן וּדְבַשׁ֙ הֶֽאֱכַלְתִּ֔יךְ וּנְתַתִּ֧יהוּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֛ם לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ וַיֶּ֑הִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·laḥ·mî ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tî lāḵ sō·leṯ wā·še·men ū·ḏə·ḇaš he·’ĕ·ḵal·tîḵ ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hū lip̄·nê·hem lə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ way·ye·hî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And you set before them as a pleasing aroma the food I had given you the fine flour oil and honey that I had fed you That is what happened declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Puseste diante delas em suave cheiro o meu pão que te dei, a flor de farinha, e o azeite, e o mel com que te nutri, e assim se fez, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֞י אֶת־ בָּנַ֤יִךְ וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלַ֣דְתְּ לִ֔י וַתִּזְבָּחִ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם לֶאֱכ֑וֹל הַמְעַ֖ט מִתַּזְנֻתֵךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·ḥî ’eṯ- bā·na·yiḵ wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’ă·šer yā·laḏt lî wat·tiz·bā·ḥîm lā·hem le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl ham·‘aṭ mit·taz·nu·ṯēḵ
verses.literal: You even took the sons and daughters you bore to Me and sacrificed them as food to idols Was your prostitution not enough
verses.literalPt: Demais, tomaste teus filhos e tuas filhas, que me geraste, e lhos sacrificaste para serem devorados pelas chamas. Acaso, foram as tuas fornicações coisa de tão pouca monta,

verses.original: וַֽתִּשְׁחֲטִ֖י אֶת־ בָּנָ֑י וַֽתִּתְּנִ֔ים בְּהַעֲבִ֥יר אוֹתָ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·ḥă·ṭî ’eṯ- bā·nāy wat·tit·tə·nîm bə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr ’ō·w·ṯām lā·hem
verses.literal: You slaughtered My children and delivered them up through the fire to idols
verses.literalPt: que mataste os meus filhos e os entregaste, fazendo que para elas passassem pelo fogo?

verses.original: וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְתַזְנֻתַ֔יִךְ לֹ֥א זָכַרְתִּי אֶת־ יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ בִּֽהְיוֹתֵךְ֙ עֵרֹ֣ם וְעֶרְיָ֔ה מִתְבּוֹסֶ֥סֶת בְּדָמֵ֖ךְ הָיִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯa·yiḵ wə·ṯaz·nu·ṯa·yiḵ lō zå̄·ḵar·tī ’eṯ- yə·mê nə·‘ū·rā·yiḵ bih·yō·w·ṯêḵ ‘ê·rōm wə·‘er·yāh miṯ·bō·w·se·seṯ bə·ḏā·mêḵ hā·yîṯ
verses.literal: And in all your abominations and acts of prostitution you did not remember the days of your youth when you were naked and bare wallowing in your own blood . . .
verses.literalPt: Em todas as tuas abominações e fornicações, não te lembraste dos dias da tua mocidade, quando estavas nua, e despida, e envolta no teu sangue.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י אַחֲרֵ֖י כָּל־ רָעָתֵ֑ךְ א֣וֹי א֣וֹי לָ֔ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯêḵ ’ō·w ’ō·w lāḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Woe Woe to you declares the Lord GOD And in addition to all your other wickedness
verses.literalPt: Depois de toda a tua maldade (ai, ai de ti! — diz o Senhor Jeová),

verses.original: וַתִּבְנִי־ לָ֖ךְ גֶּ֑ב וַתַּעֲשִׂי־ לָ֥ךְ רָמָ֖ה בְּכָל־ רְחֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḇ·nî- lāḵ gɛḇ wat·ta·‘ă·śî- lāḵ rā·māh bə·ḵāl rə·ḥō·wḇ
verses.literal: you built yourself a mound and made yourself a lofty shrine in every public square
verses.literalPt: edificaste para ti lugares altos em todas as ruas.

verses.original: אֶל־ כָּל־ רֹ֣אשׁ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בָּנִית֙ רָֽמָתֵ֔ךְ וַתְּתַֽעֲבִי֙ אֶת־ יָפְיֵ֔ךְ וַתְּפַשְּׂקִ֥י אֶת־ רַגְלַ֖יִךְ לְכָל־ עוֹבֵ֑ר וַתַּרְבִּ֖י אֶת־ תַּזְנֻתֵךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- kāl- rōš de·reḵ bā·nîṯ rā·mā·ṯêḵ wat·tə·ṯa·‘ă·ḇî ’eṯ- yā·p̄ə·yêḵ wat·tə·p̄aś·śə·qî ’eṯ- raḡ·la·yiḵ lə·ḵāl ‘ō·w·ḇêr wat·tar·bî ’eṯ- taz·nu·ṯēḵ
verses.literal: At the head of every street you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty With increasing promiscuity you spread your legs to all who passed by
verses.literalPt: Edificaste a cada canto do caminho o teu lugar alto, e prostituíste a tua formosura, e alargaste os teus pés a todo o que passava, e multiplicaste as tuas fornicações.

verses.original: וַתִּזְנִ֧י אֶל־ בְּנֵֽי־ מִצְרַ֛יִם שְׁכֵנַ֖יִךְ גִּדְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֑ר וַתַּרְבִּ֥י אֶת־ תַּזְנֻתֵ֖ךְ לְהַכְעִיסֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiz·nî ’el- bə·nê- miṣ·ra·yim šə·ḵê·na·yiḵ giḏ·lê ḇā·śār wat·tar·bî ’eṯ- taz·nu·ṯêḵ lə·haḵ·‘î·sê·nî
verses.literal: You prostituted yourself with your lustful . . . neighbors the Egyptians and increased your promiscuity to provoke Me to anger
verses.literalPt: Também fornicaste com os egípcios, teus vizinhos, homens corpulentos; e multiplicaste a tua fornicação, para me provocares à ira.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וָאֶגְרַ֖ע חֻקֵּ֑ךְ וָאֶתְּנֵ֞ךְ בְּנֶ֤פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הַנִּכְלָמ֖וֹת מִדַּרְכֵּ֥ךְ זִמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh nā·ṭî·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’eḡ·ra‘ ḥuq·qêḵ wā·’et·tə·nêḵ bə·ne·p̄eš śō·nə·’ō·w·ṯa·yiḵ bə·nō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm han·niḵ·lā·mō·wṯ mid·dar·kêḵ zim·māh
verses.literal: Therefore I stretched out My hand against you and reduced your portion I gave you over to the desire of those who hate you the daughters of the Philistines who were ashamed of your lewd conduct
verses.literalPt: Eis que, portanto, estendi sobre ti a minha mão, e diminuí a tua porção, e te entreguei à vontade das que te odeiam, das filhas dos filisteus, as quais se envergonhavam do teu caminho depravado.

verses.original: וַתִּזְנִי֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר מִבִּלְתִּ֖י שָׂבְעָתֵ֑ךְ וַתִּזְנִ֕ים וְגַ֖ם לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiz·nî ’el- bə·nê ’aš·šūr mib·bil·tî śā·ḇə·‘ā·ṯêḵ wat·tiz·nîm wə·ḡam lō śā·ḇā·‘at
verses.literal: Then you prostituted yourself with the Assyrians . . . because you were not yet satisfied Even after that you were still not satisfied
verses.literalPt: Também fornicaste com os assírios, porquanto eras insaciável; sim, fornicaste com eles; contudo, nem ainda ficaste satisfeita.

verses.original: וַתַּרְבִּ֧י אֶת־ תַּזְנוּתֵ֛ךְ אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן כַּשְׂדִּ֑ימָה וְגַם־ בְּזֹ֖את לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tar·bî ’eṯ- taz·nū·ṯêḵ ’el- ’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an kaś·dî·māh wə·ḡam- bə·zōṯ lō śā·ḇā·‘at
verses.literal: So you extended your promiscuity to Chaldea the land of merchants but even with this you were not satisfied
verses.literalPt: Demais, multiplicaste a tua fornicação na terra de Canaã até Caldeia e nem ainda com isso ficaste satisfeita.

verses.original: מָ֤ה אֲמֻלָה֙ לִבָּתֵ֔ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה בַּעֲשׂוֹתֵךְ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֔לֶּה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אִשָּֽׁה־ זוֹנָ֖ה שַׁלָּֽטֶת׃
verses.transliteration: māh ’ă·mu·lāh lib·bā·ṯêḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ba·‘ă·śō·w·ṯêḵ ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh ma·‘ă·śêh ’iš·šāh- zō·w·nāh šal·lā·ṭeṯ
verses.literal: How weak-willed is your heart declares the Lord GOD while you do all these things the acts of a shameless . . . prostitute
verses.literalPt: Quão enfraquecido está o teu coração, diz o Senhor Jeová, fazendo tu todas essas coisas, obras duma mulher meretriz e desenfreada,

verses.original: בִּבְנוֹתַ֤יִךְ גַּבֵּךְ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כָּל־ דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְרָמָתֵ֥ךְ עָשִׂיתִי בְּכָל־ רְח֑וֹב וְלֹא־ הָיִיתי כַּזּוֹנָ֖ה לְקַלֵּ֥ס אֶתְנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: biḇ·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ gab·bêḵ bə·rōš kāl- de·reḵ wə·rā·mā·ṯêḵ ʿå̄·śī·ṯī bə·ḵāl rə·ḥō·wḇ wə·lō- hå̄·yī·ṯ kaz·zō·w·nāh lə·qal·lês ’eṯ·nān
verses.literal: But when you built your mounds at the head of every street and made your lofty shrines in every public square you were not even like a prostitute because you scorned payment
verses.literalPt: edificando a tua câmara abobadada no canto de todos os caminhos e fazendo o teu lugar alto em todas as ruas! Não tens sido como a meretriz, visto que desprezas a paga.

verses.original: הָאִשָּׁ֖ה הַמְּנָאָ֑פֶת תַּ֣חַת אִישָׁ֔הּ תִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־ זָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’iš·šāh ham·mə·nā·’ā·p̄eṯ ta·ḥaṯ ’î·šāh tiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- zā·rîm
verses.literal: You adulterous wife . . . You receive strangers instead of your own husband
verses.literalPt: Mulher que comete adultério, que, em lugar do marido recebe os estrangeiros!

verses.original: לְכָל־ זֹנ֖וֹת יִתְּנוּ־ נֵ֑דֶה וְאַ֨תְּ נָתַ֤תְּ אֶת־ נְדָנַ֙יִךְ֙ לְכָל־ מְאַֽהֲבַ֔יִךְ וַתִּשְׁחֳדִ֣י אוֹתָ֗ם לָב֥וֹא אֵלַ֛יִךְ מִסָּבִ֖יב בְּתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵāl zō·nō·wṯ yit·tə·nū- nê·ḏeh wə·’at nā·ṯat ’eṯ- nə·ḏā·na·yiḵ lə·ḵāl mə·’a·hă·ḇa·yiḵ wat·tiš·ḥo·ḏî ’ō·w·ṯām lā·ḇō·w ’ê·la·yiḵ mis·sā·ḇîḇ bə·ṯaz·nū·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Men give gifts to all their prostitutes but you gave gifts to all your lovers You bribed them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors
verses.literalPt: A todas as prostitutas se dá a sua paga, mas tu pagas a todos os teus amantes e lhes dás peitas, para que de todos os lados venham para fornicarem contigo.

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ בָ֨ךְ הֵ֤פֶךְ מִן־ הַנָּשִׁים֙ בְּתַזְנוּתַ֔יִךְ וְאַחֲרַ֖יִךְ לֹ֣א זוּנָּ֑ה וּבְתִתֵּ֣ךְ אֶתְנָ֗ן וְאֶתְנַ֛ן לֹ֥א נִתַּן־ לָ֖ךְ וַתְּהִ֥י לְהֶֽפֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- ḇāḵ hê·p̄eḵ min- han·nā·šîm bə·ṯaz·nū·ṯa·yiḵ wə·’a·ḥă·ra·yiḵ lō zūn·nāh ū·ḇə·ṯit·têḵ ’eṯ·nān wə·’eṯ·nan lō nit·tan- lāḵ wat·tə·hî lə·he·p̄eḵ
verses.literal: So your prostitution is the opposite of that of other women No one solicited your favors and you paid a fee instead of receiving one so you are the very opposite
verses.literalPt: A ti sucede o contrário do que sucede a outras mulheres; tu fornicas, e ninguém anda após ti para fornicar; tu dás a paga, e a ti não se te dá a paga; por isso, és diferente das outras.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן זוֹנָ֔ה שִׁמְעִ֖י דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên zō·w·nāh šim·‘î də·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore O prostitute hear the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Portanto, ó meretriz, ouve a palavra de Jeová:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה יַ֣עַן הִשָּׁפֵ֤ךְ נְחֻשְׁתֵּךְ֙ וַתִּגָּלֶ֣ה עֶרְוָתֵ֔ךְ בְּתַזְנוּתַ֖יִךְ עַל־ מְאַהֲבָ֑יִךְ וְעַל֙ כָּל־ גִּלּוּלֵ֣י תוֹעֲבוֹתַ֔יִךְ וְכִדְמֵ֣י בָנַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תְּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an hiš·šā·p̄êḵ nə·ḥuš·têḵ wat·tig·gā·leh ‘er·wā·ṯêḵ bə·ṯaz·nū·ṯa·yiḵ ‘al- mə·’a·hă·ḇā·yiḵ wə·‘al kāl- gil·lū·lê ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ wə·ḵiḏ·mê ḇā·na·yiḵ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat lā·hem
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because you poured out your wealth and exposed your nakedness in your promiscuity with your lovers and with all your detestable idols and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porquanto foi excessiva a tua lascívia e descoberta a tua nudez nas tuas fornicações com os teus amantes; por causa também de todos os ídolos das tuas abominações e do sangue de teus filhos que lhes deste,

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן הִנְנִ֨י מְקַבֵּ֤ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ מְאַהֲבַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָרַ֣בְתְּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהַ֔בְתְּ עַ֖ל כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את וְקִבַּצְתִּי֩ אֹתָ֨ם עָלַ֜יִךְ מִסָּבִ֗יב וְגִלֵּיתִ֤י עֶרְוָתֵךְ֙ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְרָא֖וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ עֶרְוָתֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî mə·qab·bêṣ ’eṯ- kāl- mə·’a·hă·ḇa·yiḵ ’ă·šer ‘ā·raḇt ‘ă·lê·hem wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ā·haḇt ‘al kāl- ’ă·šer śā·nêṯ wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’ō·ṯām ‘ā·la·yiḵ mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḡil·lê·ṯî ‘er·wā·ṯêḵ ’ă·lê·hem wə·rā·’ū ’eṯ- kāl- ‘er·wā·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: therefore I will surely gather all the lovers with whom you found pleasure all those you loved and all those you hated I will gather them against you from all around and expose you before them and they will see you completely naked
verses.literalPt: portanto, eis que ajuntarei todos os teus amantes, com os quais te deleitaste, e todos os que amaste, juntamente com todos os que aborreceste; ajuntá-los-ei de todas as partes contra ti e descobrir-lhes-ei a tua nudez, para que vejam toda a tua nudez.

verses.original: וּשְׁפַטְתִּיךְ֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵ֣י נֹאֲפ֔וֹת וְשֹׁפְכֹ֖ת דָּ֑ם וּנְתַתִּ֕יךְ דַּ֥ם חֵמָ֖ה וְקִנְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·p̄aṭ·tîḵ miš·pə·ṭê nō·’ă·p̄ō·wṯ wə·šō·p̄ə·ḵōṯ dām ū·nə·ṯat·tîḵ dam ḥê·māh wə·qin·’āh
verses.literal: And I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and those who shed blood so I will bring upon you the wrath of your bloodshed and jealousy
verses.literalPt: Julgar-te-ei como são julgadas as adúlteras e as que derramam sangue; e te entregarei ao sangue de furor e de ciúme.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י אוֹתָ֜ךְ בְּיָדָ֗ם וְהָרְס֤וּ גַבֵּךְ֙ וְנִתְּצ֣וּ רָמֹתַ֔יִךְ וְהִפְשִׁ֤יטוּ אוֹתָךְ֙ בְּגָדַ֔יִךְ וְלָקְח֖וּ כְּלֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֑ךְ וְהִנִּיח֖וּךְ עֵירֹ֥ם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bə·yā·ḏām wə·hā·rə·sū ḡab·bêḵ wə·nit·tə·ṣū rā·mō·ṯa·yiḵ wə·hip̄·šî·ṭū ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bə·ḡā·ḏa·yiḵ wə·lā·qə·ḥū kə·lê ṯip̄·’ar·têḵ wə·hin·nî·ḥūḵ ‘ê·rōm wə·‘er·yāh
verses.literal: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers and they will level your mounds and tear down your lofty shrines They will strip off your clothes take your fine jewelry and leave you naked and bare
verses.literalPt: Também te entregarei nas mãos dos teus inimigos, que derribarão a tua câmara abobadada e demolirão os teus lugares altos; que te despirão os teus vestidos, tomarão as tuas belas joias e te deixarão nua e despida.

verses.original: וְהֶעֱל֤וּ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ קָהָ֔ל וְרָגְמ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖ךְ בָּאָ֑בֶן וּבִתְּק֖וּךְ בְּחַרְבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·lū ‘ā·la·yiḵ qā·hāl wə·rā·ḡə·mū ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bā·’ā·ḇen ū·ḇit·tə·qūḵ bə·ḥar·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: They will bring a mob against you who will stone you . . . and cut you to pieces with their swords
verses.literalPt: Também convocarão contra ti uma assembleia, e com pedras te apedrejarão, e te traspassarão com as suas espadas.

verses.original: וְשָׂרְפ֤וּ בָתַּ֙יִךְ֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְעָשׂוּ־ בָ֣ךְ שְׁפָטִ֔ים לְעֵינֵ֖י נָשִׁ֣ים רַבּ֑וֹת וְהִשְׁבַּתִּיךְ֙ מִזּוֹנָ֔ה וְגַם־ אֶתְנַ֖ן לֹ֥א תִתְּנִי־ עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·rə·p̄ū ḇāt·ta·yiḵ bā·’êš wə·‘ā·śū- ḇāḵ šə·p̄ā·ṭîm lə·‘ê·nê nā·šîm rab·bō·wṯ wə·hiš·bat·tîḵ miz·zō·w·nāh wə·ḡam- ’eṯ·nan lō ṯit·tə·nî- ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Then they will burn down . . . your houses and execute judgment against you in the sight of many women I will put an end to your prostitution and you will never . . . again pay your lovers
verses.literalPt: Abrasarão com fogo as tuas casas e executarão sobre ti juízos à vista de muitas mulheres. Farei que cesses de fornicar, e não tornarás mais a dar paga.

verses.original: וַהֲנִחֹתִ֤י חֲמָתִי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְסָ֥רָה קִנְאָתִ֖י מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְשָׁ֣קַטְתִּ֔י וְלֹ֥א אֶכְעַ֖ס עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ni·ḥō·ṯî ḥă·mā·ṯî bāḵ wə·sā·rāh qin·’ā·ṯî mim·mêḵ wə·šā·qaṭ·tî wə·lō ’eḵ·‘as ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: So I will lay to rest My wrath against you and My jealousy will turn away from you Then I will be calm and no longer angry
verses.literalPt: Assim, satisfarei em ti o meu furor, e se desviarão de ti os meus ciúmes; ficarei tranquilo e não me tornarei mais a irar.

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ זָכַרְתִּי אֶת־ יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרַ֔יִךְ וַתִּרְגְּזִי־ לִ֖י בְּכָל־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְגַם־ אֲנִ֨י הֵ֜א דַּרְכֵּ֣ךְ׀ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ נָתַ֗תִּי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְלֹ֤א עָשִׂיתִי אֶת־ הַזִּמָּ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer lō- zå̄·ḵar·tī ’eṯ- yə·mê nə·‘ū·ra·yiḵ wat·tir·gə·zî- lî bə·ḵāl ’êl·leh wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî hê dar·kêḵ bə·rōš nā·ṯat·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·lō ʿå̄·śī·ṯī ’eṯ- haz·zim·māh ‘al kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged Me with all these things . . . I will surely bring your deeds down upon your own head declares the Lord GOD Have you not committed this lewdness on top of all your other abominations
verses.literalPt: Porque não te lembraste dos dias da tua mocidade, mas me irritaste por todas estas coisas; por isso, eis que farei recair o teu caminho sobre a tua cabeça, diz o Senhor Jeová; e, a todas as suas abominações não acrescentarás esta depravidade.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ כָּל־ הַמֹּשֵׁ֔ל עָלַ֥יִךְ יִמְשֹׁ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּאִמָּ֖ה בִּתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh kāl- ham·mō·šêl ‘ā·la·yiḵ yim·šōl lê·mōr kə·’im·māh bit·tāh
verses.literal: Behold all who speak in proverbs will quote this proverb . . . about you Like mother like daughter
verses.literalPt: Eis que todo o que usa de provérbios usará contra ti este provérbio: Tal mãe, tal filha.

verses.original: בַּת־ אִמֵּ֣ךְ אַ֔תְּ גֹּעֶ֥לֶת אִישָׁ֖הּ וּבָנֶ֑יהָ וַאֲח֨וֹת אֲחוֹתֵ֜ךְ אַ֗תְּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר גָּֽעֲ֙לוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ן וּבְנֵיהֶ֔ן אִמְּכֶ֣ן חִתִּ֔ית וַאֲבִיכֶ֖ן אֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: baṯ- ’im·mêḵ ’at gō·‘e·leṯ ’î·šāh ū·ḇā·ne·hā wa·’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ ’at ’ă·šer gā·‘ă·lū ’an·šê·hen ū·ḇə·nê·hen ’im·mə·ḵen ḥit·tîṯ wa·’ă·ḇî·ḵen ’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: You are the daughter of your mother who despised her husband and children You are the sister of your sisters who despised their husbands and children Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite
verses.literalPt: Tu és filha de tua mãe, que tem nojo de seu marido e de seus filhos; e tu és irmã de tuas irmãs, que tinham nojo de seus maridos e de seus filhos; vossa mãe era heteia, e vosso pai, amorreu.

verses.original: וַאֲחוֹתֵ֨ךְ הַגְּדוֹלָ֤ה שֹֽׁמְרוֹן֙ הִ֣יא וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ הַיּוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת עַל־ שְׂמֹאולֵ֑ךְ וַאֲחוֹתֵ֞ךְ הַקְּטַנָּ֣ה מִמֵּ֗ךְ הַיּוֹשֶׁ֙בֶת֙ מִֽימִינֵ֔ךְ סְדֹ֖ם וּבְנוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh šō·mə·rō·wn hî ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā hay·yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ‘al- śə·mō·w·lêḵ wa·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ haq·qə·ṭan·nāh mim·mêḵ hay·yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ mî·mî·nêḵ sə·ḏōm ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Your older sister was Samaria who lived with her daughters to your north and your younger sister was Sodom who lived with her daughters to your south
verses.literalPt: Tua irmã maior é Samaria, que habita à tua mão esquerda, juntamente com suas filhas; e tua irmã menor, que habita à tua mão direita, é Sodoma e suas filhas.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א בְדַרְכֵיהֶן֙ הָלַ֔כְתְּ וּבְתוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֖ן עָשִׂיתִי כִּמְעַ֣ט קָ֔ט וַתַּשְׁחִ֥תִי מֵהֵ֖ן בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ḇə·ḏar·ḵê·hen hā·laḵt ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hen ʿå̄·śī·ṯī kim·‘aṭ qāṭ wat·taš·ḥi·ṯî mê·hên bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵā·yiḵ
verses.literal: And you not only walked in their - ways and practiced their abominations but soon you were . . . more depraved than they were
verses.literalPt: Contudo, não andaste nos seus caminhos, nem fizeste conforme as suas abominações; porém, como se isso fora coisa de pouca monta, foste mais corrompida do que elas em todos os teus caminhos.

verses.original: חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אִם־ עָֽשְׂתָה֙ סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ הִ֖יא וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית אַ֖תְּ וּבְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- ‘ā·śə·ṯāh sə·ḏōm ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ hî ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ ’at ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: As surely as I live declares the Lord GOD your sister . . . Sodom and her daughters never did as you and your daughters have done
verses.literalPt: Pela minha vida, diz o Senhor Jeová, não fez Sodoma, tua irmã, nem ela nem suas filhas, como fizeste tu e tuas filhas.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ זֶ֣ה הָיָ֔ה עֲוֺ֖ן סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֑ךְ גָּא֨וֹן שִׂבְעַת־ לֶ֜חֶם וְשַׁלְוַ֣ת הַשְׁקֵ֗ט הָ֤יָה לָהּ֙ וְלִבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיַד־ עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֖וֹן לֹ֥א הֶחֱזִֽיקָה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- zeh hā·yāh ‘ă·wōn sə·ḏōm ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ gā·’ō·wn śiḇ·‘aṯ- le·ḥem wə·šal·waṯ haš·qêṭ hā·yāh lāh wə·liḇ·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·yaḏ- ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn lō he·ḥĕ·zî·qāh
verses.literal: Now this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom She and her daughters . . . were arrogant overfed . . . and complacent . . . they did not help the poor and needy
verses.literalPt: Eis que esta era a iniquidade de Sodoma, tua irmã: a soberba, a fartura de pão e a próspera tranquilidade achavam-se nela e em suas filhas, porém não segurava ela a mão do pobre e do necessitado.

verses.original: וַֽתִּגְבְּהֶ֔ינָה וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה תוֹעֵבָ֖ה לְפָנָ֑י וָאָסִ֥יר אֶתְהֶ֖ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִֽיתִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḡ·bə·he·nāh wat·ta·‘ă·śe·nāh ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh lə·p̄ā·nāy wā·’ā·sîr ’eṯ·hen ka·’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî
verses.literal: Thus they were haughty and committed abominations before Me Therefore I removed them as you have seen
verses.literalPt: Eram arrogantes e cometeram abominações diante de mim; portanto, ao ver isso, as removi do seu lugar.

verses.original: וְשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן כַּחֲצִ֥י חַטֹּאתַ֖יִךְ לֹ֣א חָטָ֑אָה וַתַּרְבִּ֤י אֶת־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ מֵהֵ֔נָּה וַתְּצַדְּקִי֙ אֶת־ אֲחוֹתֵךְ בְּכָל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֖יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂיתי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·mə·rō·wn ka·ḥă·ṣî ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯa·yiḵ lō ḥā·ṭā·’āh wat·tar·bî ’eṯ- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ mê·hên·nāh wat·tə·ṣad·də·qî ’eṯ- ʾă·ḥō·ṯēḵ bə·ḵāl tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’ă·šer ʿå̄·śī·ṯ
verses.literal: Furthermore, Samaria did not commit half the sins you did You have multiplied your abominations beyond theirs and all the abominations you have committed have made your sisters appear righteous
verses.literalPt: Também Samaria não cometeu a metade dos teus pecados, mas tu multiplicaste as tuas abominações mais do que elas e justificaste tuas irmãs por todas as tuas abominações que praticaste.

verses.original: גַּם־ אַ֣תְּ׀ שְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֗ךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּלַּלְתְּ֙ לַֽאֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ בְּחַטֹּאתַ֛יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־ הִתְעַ֥בְתְּ מֵהֵ֖ן תִּצְדַּ֣קְנָה מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְגַם־ אַ֥תְּ בּ֙וֹשִׁי֙ וּשְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֔ךְ בְּצַדֶּקְתֵּ֖ךְ אַחְיוֹתֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’at śə·’î ḵə·lim·mā·ṯêḵ ’ă·šer pil·lalt la·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ bə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯa·yiḵ ’ă·šer- hiṯ·‘aḇt mê·hên tiṣ·daq·nāh mim·mêḵ wə·ḡam- ’at bō·wō·šî ū·śə·’î ḵə·lim·mā·ṯêḵ bə·ṣad·deq·têḵ ’aḥ·yō·w·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: So now you must bear your disgrace since you have brought justification for your sisters For they appear more righteous than you because your sins were more vile than theirs So you too must bear your shame and disgrace since you have made your sisters appear righteous
verses.literalPt: Tu também, que deste sentença favorável a tuas irmãs, leva a tua vergonha; pelos teus pecados que cometeste mais abomináveis do que elas, são elas mais justas do que tu; confunde-te também e leva a tua vergonha, pois justificaste tuas irmãs.

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ שְׁבִ֣יתְהֶ֔ן אֶת־ שְׁבִית סְדֹם֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ שְׁבִית שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ וּשְׁבִית שְׁבִיתַ֖יִךְ בְּתוֹכָֽהְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- šə·ḇî·ṯə·hen ’eṯ- šə·ḇīṯ sə·ḏōm ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·’eṯ- šə·ḇīṯ šō·mə·rō·wn ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ū·šə·ḇīṯ šə·ḇî·ṯa·yiḵ bə·ṯō·w·ḵā·hə·nāh
verses.literal: But I will restore - Sodom and her daughters from captivity as well as Samaria and her daughters And I will restore you . . . along with them
verses.literalPt: Farei voltar o cativeiro delas, o cativeiro de Sodoma e de suas filhas, e o cativeiro de Samaria e de suas filhas, e o cativeiro dos teus cativos no meio delas,

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ תִּשְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֔ךְ וְנִכְלַ֕מְתְּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית בְּנַחֲמֵ֖ךְ אֹתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tiś·’î ḵə·lim·mā·ṯêḵ wə·niḵ·lamt mik·kōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ bə·na·ḥă·mêḵ ’ō·ṯān
verses.literal: So you will bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you did to comfort them
verses.literalPt: para que leves a tua vergonha e sejas envergonhada por causa de tudo o que tens feito, servindo-lhes de conforto.

verses.original: וַאֲחוֹתַ֗יִךְ סְדֹ֤ם וּבְנוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ תָּשֹׁ֣בְןָ לְקַדְמָתָ֔ן וְשֹֽׁמְרוֹן֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ תָּשֹׁ֖בְןָ לְקַדְמָתָ֑ן וְאַתְּ֙ וּבְנוֹתַ֔יִךְ תְּשֻׁבֶ֖ינָה לְקַדְמַתְכֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥō·w·ṯa·yiḵ sə·ḏōm ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā tā·šō·ḇə·nā lə·qaḏ·mā·ṯān wə·šō·mə·rō·wn ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā tā·šō·ḇə·nā lə·qaḏ·mā·ṯān wə·’at ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ tə·šu·ḇe·nāh lə·qaḏ·maṯ·ḵen
verses.literal: And your sisters Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters will return to their former state You and your daughters . . . . . . will also return to your former state
verses.literalPt: Tuas irmãs, Sodoma e suas filhas, tornarão ao seu estado primitivo, e Samaria e suas filhas tornarão ao seu estado primitivo, e tu e tuas filhas tornareis ao vosso estado primitivo.

verses.original: וְל֤וֹא הָֽיְתָה֙ סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ לִשְׁמוּעָ֖ה בְּפִ֑יךְ בְּי֖וֹם גְּאוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō·w hā·yə·ṯāh sə·ḏōm ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯêḵ liš·mū·‘āh bə·p̄îḵ bə·yō·wm gə·’ō·w·nā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Did you not treat . . . your sister Sodom as an object of scorn in the day of your pride
verses.literalPt: Pois tua irmã Sodoma não foi mencionada pela tua boca no dia da tua soberba,

verses.original: בְּטֶרֶם֮ תִּגָּלֶ֣ה רָעָתֵךְ֒ כְּמ֗וֹ עֵ֚ת חֶרְפַּ֣ת בְּנוֹת־ אֲרָ֔ם וְכָל־ סְבִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים הַשָּׁאט֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖ךְ מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem tig·gā·leh rā·‘ā·ṯêḵ kə·mōw ‘êṯ ḥer·paṯ bə·nō·wṯ- ’ă·rām wə·ḵāl sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā bə·nō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm haš·šā·ṭō·wṯ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: before your wickedness was uncovered Even so you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all those around her and by the daughters of the Philistines all those around you who despise you
verses.literalPt: antes que fosse descoberta a tua maldade, como ela o foi no tempo do opróbrio das filhas da Síria e de todos os que estão ao redor dela, isto é, das filhas dos filisteus, que te desprezam.

verses.original: אֶת־ זִמָּתֵ֥ךְ וְאֶת־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֖יִךְ אַ֣תְּ נְשָׂאתִ֑ים נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- zim·mā·ṯêḵ wə·’eṯ- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’at nə·śā·ṯîm nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your abominations declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: A tua depravidade e as tuas abominações, levaste-as tu, diz Jeová.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְעָשִׂית אוֹתָ֖ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית אֲשֶׁר־ בָּזִ֥ית אָלָ֖ה לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·ʿå̄·śīṯ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ ’ă·šer- bā·zîṯ ’ā·lāh lə·hā·p̄êr bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says I will deal with you according to your deeds since you have despised the oath by breaking the covenant
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Também te farei a ti como fizeste, tu que desprezaste o juramento, invalidando a aliança.

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֛י אוֹתָ֖ךְ בִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ וַהֲקִמוֹתִ֥י לָ֖ךְ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tî ’ă·nî ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bî·mê nə·‘ū·rā·yiḵ wa·hă·qi·mō·w·ṯî lāḵ bə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: But I will remember the covenant . . . I made with you in the days of your youth and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you
verses.literalPt: Contudo, eu me lembrarei da minha aliança contigo nos dias da tua mocidade e estabelecerei contigo uma aliança eterna.

verses.original: וְזָכַ֣רְתְּ אֶת־ דְּרָכַיִךְ֮ וְנִכְלַמְתְּ֒ בְּקַחְתֵּ֗ךְ אֶת־ אֲחוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ הַגְּדֹל֣וֹת מִמֵּ֔ךְ אֶל־ הַקְּטַנּ֖וֹת מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶתְהֶ֥ן לָ֛ךְ לְבָנ֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א מִבְּרִיתֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵart ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵa·yiḵ wə·niḵ·lamt bə·qaḥ·têḵ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯa·yiḵ hag·gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ mim·mêḵ ’el- haq·qə·ṭan·nō·wṯ mim·mêḵ wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ·hen lāḵ lə·ḇā·nō·wṯ wə·lō mib·bə·rî·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your older and younger . . . sisters I will give them to you as daughters but not because of My covenant with you
verses.literalPt: Então, te lembrarás dos teus caminhos e ficarás envergonhada, quando receberes as tuas irmãs, as irmãs mais velhas e bem assim as irmãs mais moças; e tas darei por filhas, porém não pela tua aliança.

verses.original: וַהֲקִימוֹתִ֥י אֲנִ֛י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qî·mō·w·ṯî ’ă·nî ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tāḵ wə·yā·ḏa·‘at kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: So I will establish My covenant with you and you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eu estabelecerei a minha aliança contigo e saberás que eu sou Jeová,

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן תִּזְכְּרִי֙ וָבֹ֔שְׁתְּ וְלֹ֨א יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֥ךְ עוֹד֙ פִּתְח֣וֹן פֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י כְּלִמָּתֵ֑ךְ בְּכַפְּרִי־ לָךְ֙ לְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tiz·kə·rî wā·ḇō·šət wə·lō yih·yeh- lāḵ ‘ō·wḏ piṯ·ḥō·wn peh mip·pə·nê kə·lim·mā·ṯêḵ bə·ḵap·pə·rî- lāḵ lə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: so that when I make atonement for all you have done you will remember and be ashamed and never . . . again open your mouth because of your disgrace declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: para que te lembres, e fiques confundida, e não abras mais a tua boca por causa da tua vergonha, quando eu te houver perdoado tudo o que fizeste, diz o Senhor Jeová.
